summary.source: all 120 Hz post-integration physical states; display curves do not define statistics
summary.heightResponseMeaning: Settling is measured from the 1 s start of the constant target, at every 120 Hz state; the final uninterrupted height/vertical-speed band must persist at least 0.5 s through 6 s. Null means no qualification in that window. Overshoot uses the same 1–6 s window. Fixed-window gas is 0–6 s only; partial failed runs retain their shorter duration.
summary.recoveryMeaning: Time from the last applied scheduled wind change to sustained stable landing, including commanded descent; not isolated wind-response settling time.
summary.clearanceMeaning: Minimum vertical AABB hull gap to the actual flat laboratory floor; estimate of collision envelope, not tyre travel, city AGL, or recovery height.

restored: model parameter settings including gas supply mode
retained: actual remaining gas mass; no refill
